hypotheses.reasoning: search-api was rolled out to v1.12.0 at 17:05:28 (#2801, started #2887). Within ~2 minutes, requests fail with TypeError reading 'currency' at product-formatter.ts:167 (#3128, #3214, #3366, #3530), all tagged v1.12.0. These direct failures produce the /search 500s that web-bff reports as 'upstream search-api returned 500' (#3054, #3271, #4637 etc.). Pre-deploy, /search returned 200 (#2806). The 500 rate (11%) is consistent with only a subset of products lacking a currency field hitting the formatter. The gateway/BFF 500s are downstream symptoms and not cited. Account-svc OOM and billing invoice checksum errors are concurrent but separate noise: they do not touch /search (account-svc affects /login via edge-proxy; billing archive checksum is in a 2019 partition).

Billing invoice_archive checksum violations in the 2019 archive partitions are real data corruption but they are in billing-reconciler, not on the /search path, and started before the alert window's spike. Unlikely to explain /search 500s.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back search-api from v1.12.0 to v1.11.6 immediately (build b0a1c89 is the bad build), which should stop the product-formatter TypeError and restore /search. Then fix product-formatter.ts:167 to handle products with missing currency (or fix the catalog data), and re-deploy with a test covering products lacking currency. Separately, open tickets for account-svc OOM (userCache growth, 2Gi limit, #2412/#2942/#3443) and billing-reconciler archive checksum failures (#1521), which are not the cause of this /search incident.
